name: skiaui
description: Agent skills for SkiaUi (SkiaUi.Maui), the Skia-drawn UI library for .NET MAUI.

plugins.name: skiaui-migration
plugins.description: Audit a .NET MAUI app for a SkiaUi migration, convert pages, custom controls and gestures to drawn controls, and match the drawn controls to the app's MAUI controls.

plugins.name: skiaui-devflow
plugins.description: Make a SkiaUi app controllable by .NET MAUI DevFlow: adds the dev.skiaui agent extension (drawn element tree with window bounds, taps that report whether a drawn tap recognizer took them, hit-testing).
